title: Dana-Farber, Beth Israel begin construction of new $1.68 billion cancer hospital - The Boston Globe
description: The groundbreaking marks a new phase in the competition with Mass General Brigham. About 2,400 workers will be hired at the facility over the next four years.

title: Elon Musk says he's giving SpaceX stock to every kid in America - Yahoo Finance

title: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts likely out for season after blood clots found in lungs and leg - NBC News
description: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts was diagnosed with blood clots in his lungs and leg, the team said Monday, likely sidelining the Super Bowl MVP for the rest of 2026.

title: CNN anchor Christiane Amanpour to leave network after 43 years - BBC
description: The network's chief international anchor has covered wars including Rwanda, Afghanistan, Ukraine and Iran.
